title: ResourceReference
description: JSON Schema enforces field shape and whole-array uniqueness. It cannot compare resource_id with dependency_ids or assert identifier ordering; ValidateResourceManifest must reject self-dependency and noncanonical dependency ordering. Schema conformance alone does not establish a resolvable or accepted resource.

dependency_ids.description: Whole-array duplicates are rejected here. Strict identifier ordering and the cross-value rule that resource_id must not occur in dependency_ids are semantic-validator responsibilities.
